title: Uzungumzaji wa Papo kwa Hapo (Theme 8: Uhalifu wa mtandaoni)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 8 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child plans what to say, listens to the end, and replies on the topic in standard Kiswahili with the features of a papo.
steps: Reply on the topic with a reason.
Keep the language and the turn-taking right.

board.do: jinsi ya kujikinga na wezi wa mtandaoni
Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child takes part in a short papo on the topic while a partner ticks the checklist.

misconceptions.repair: Panga hoja chache kichwani kabla ya kuanza.
Ni bora kunyamaza kidogo kuliko kusema "ee" kila mara.

misconceptions.ask: Ni maneno yapi si ya Kiswahili sanifu?
misconceptions.repair: Tumia Kiswahili sanifu katika mazungumzo rasmi.

checks.question: Umepewa mada ghafla. Ufanye nini kwanza?
checks.answer: fikiri hoja tatu kwa sekunde chache, kisha anza
